# Pull quotes prompt — NOTE: quotes are NOT generated by the AI.

Pull quotes are picked by the local extractor as EXACT sentences copied from
the transcript. This file exists so the prompt set is complete, but the code
deliberately does not ask Gemini to write quotes: a model must never invent
a quotation and attribute it to the speaker.

If you edit this file, edit the SELECTION taste only (e.g. "prefer quotes with
numbers" vs "prefer quotes with contrast"). The words always come from the transcript.
